info.name: Because Future API - V2
info.description:
API collection for Because Future backend - Version 2

Uses Gemini (Nano Banana) API for background removal and try-on processing
Local file storage in /images directory
Custom form-based authentication with JWT
Wardrobe management with platform and user-created category sections

ENVIRONMENT SETUP:
1. Import postman_environment_local.json for Local Development (http://localhost:8000)
2. Import postman_environment_remote.json for Remote Production (http://34.32.121.88:5001)
3. Select environment from dropdown (top-right in Postman)
4. All requests will use {{base_url}} from the selected environment

=== RECENT CHANGES (V2 - 2026-06-11) ===

Wishlist Management:
• NEW: DELETE /api/wardrobe/wishlist/{id} - Remove item from wishlist
• NEW: POST /api/wardrobe/wishlist/{id}/move-to-wardrobe - Move to wardrobe

Analytics & Daily Reports:
• Event tracking for login, signup, delete_account, try-on
• Daily XLSX reports emailed, then data wiped

Avatar Validation Improvements:
• Smarter full-body detection with face size heuristic
• Better error messages with rejection codes

=== CHANGES (V2 - 2026-06-01) ===

Search Screen API (#40):
• NEW: GET /api/wardrobe/search - Extract product from URL or get default garments
• With ?url= param: Scrapes product info from URL
• Without URL: Returns default garments catalog
• Returns: garmentURL, name, brand, imageURL, category, isRecent
• Requires authentication

Wishlist Duplicate Prevention:
• UPDATED: POST /api/wardrobe/items - Now prevents duplicate items by URL
• Returns existing item if URL already exists in same category_section

Avatar Validation Enhancement:
• UPDATED: POST /api/save-avatar - Now requires full-body photos
• Rejects head-only images (need full figure for try-on)
• Rejects collages/group photos (multiple people)

=== PREVIOUS CHANGES (V2 - 2026-04-10) ===

Task 1 - Saved Try-ons with Garment URL:
• UPDATED: POST /api/tryon - Now saves garment_url with try-on result
• UPDATED: GET /api/job/{job_id} - Returns garment_url when job is done
• UPDATED: GET /api/job/{job_id}/result - Returns garment_url

Task 2 - Sizing Algorithm (2026-04-13):
• NEW: POST /api/sizing/recommend - Get size recommendation based on user measurements vs garment
• NEW: GET /api/sizing/garment - Get garment sizing info from Lovable DB
• Integrates with Lovable/Supabase API for garment measurements
• Compares user body measurements with garment measurements
• Returns fit analysis with confidence score

Task 3 - Default Garment URLs:
• NEW: GET /api/garments/defaults - Get default garment URLs by gender

Task 4 - Deep Linking/Social Sharing:
• Backend ready via existing POST /api/garments/scrape
• Mobile app needs to implement share intent (iOS Universal Links / Android App Links)

Task 5 - Layered Multi-Garment Try-On (2026-04-14):
• NEW: POST /api/tryon/layered - Apply multiple garments sequentially with layering
• Use case: top + jacket, shirt + blazer, dress + coat
• First garment replaces existing clothes, subsequent garments layer on top
• Synchronous processing, returns all intermediate results

Task 6 - FIT Analysis API (2026-04-17):
• NEW: POST /api/fit-analysis - Analyze garment fit against user body measurements
• 4-tier classification: body fit, good fit, loose fit, tight
• Supports upper garments (chest, sleeve, shirt length) and lower garments (waist, hip, inseam)
• Returns detailed per-measurement fit status and recommendations

item.description: FIT Analysis API - Intelligent garment fit assessment by comparing user body measurements against garment dimensions. Uses 4-tier classification: body fit, good fit, loose fit, tight.

request.description:
Analyze how well a garment would fit based on user's body measurements.

**garment_type**: 'upper' or 'lower'

**Upper garment measurements** (any of):
- chest_width, sleeve_length, shirt_length, shoulder_width, waist_width, arm_width

**Lower garment measurements** (any of):
- waist, hip, inseam, thigh_width, knee_width, calf_width, ankle_width, rise

**4-Tier Fit Classification:**
- Body Fit (<0.1cm diff): Perfect match
- Good Fit (0.1-1.9cm): Comfortable
- Loose Fit (2.0-3.9cm): Slightly oversized
- Tight (>=4cm body>garment): Too small

Requires user to have body measurements saved.
